groups.name: Technical SEO & Search Access
groups.summary: Find what prevents important pages from being discovered, rendered and indexed.

services.name: Technical SEO Audits
services.when: Several technical issues appear together or visibility has fallen.
services.work: Audit crawl paths, indexing signals, redirects, templates and canonical URLs.
services.output: Prioritized findings with affected URLs and validation checks.

services.name: Crawlability & Indexation
services.when: Important pages are missing or irrelevant URLs are indexed.
services.work: Inspect robots directives, sitemaps, HTTP statuses, internal links and Search Console evidence.
services.output: URL-level indexability and crawling action list.

services.name: JavaScript Rendering SEO
services.when: Key page content depends on JavaScript.
services.work: Compare raw HTML and rendered content, navigational links and resource loading.
services.output: Rendering issues and template-level corrections.

services.name: Core Web Vitals & Mobile Performance
services.when: Mobile pages feel slow or unstable.
services.work: Review field and lab measurements, loading bottlenecks and important layouts.
services.output: Performance priorities and measurable checks.

services.name: Structured Data & Search Appearance
services.when: Relevant markup is absent or inconsistent with visible content.
services.work: Check JSON-LD eligibility, entities, page content and parsing errors.
services.output: Validated markup recommendations without rich-result guarantees.

services.name: SEO Migrations, Redirects & Canonicals
services.when: You are redesigning, changing domains or moving URLs.
services.work: Inventory old and new URLs, assess equivalence, plan redirects and verify canonical links.
services.output: Migration map, prelaunch checks and postlaunch validation.

groups.name: Keywords, Pages & Content
groups.summary: Map distinct search needs to useful pages, without creating competing thin URLs.

services.name: Keyword Research & Clustering
services.when: You need relevant search terms and a clear page plan.
services.work: Research queries, inspect intents, group related topics and map them to pages.
services.output: Keyword clusters and keyword-to-URL map.

services.name: On-Page SEO
services.when: Existing pages are not aligned with their target searches.
services.work: Assess titles, headings, content, snippets, images and contextual links.
services.output: Page-level improvement briefs with priorities.

services.name: Content Audits & Refresh Planning
services.when: Pages are outdated, overlapping or missing needed answers.
services.work: Review usefulness, existing evidence, overlap and consolidation options.
services.output: Keep, improve, combine or retire recommendations.

services.name: SEO Content Strategy & Briefs
services.when: You need a cohesive publishing plan.
services.work: Identify unanswered questions, group topics and define useful page formats.
services.output: Prioritized topic roadmap and content briefs.

services.name: Information Architecture & Internal Linking
services.when: Visitors struggle to reach important information.
services.work: Assess site hierarchy, navigational paths, link depth and anchor clarity.
services.output: Architecture map and internal linking priorities.

services.name: Keyword Cannibalization & Intent Mapping
services.when: Several URLs appear to serve the same search intent.
services.work: Compare actual SERPs, page content and available performance signals.
services.output: One primary destination per intent and URL-specific decisions.

groups.name: Markets, Platforms & Search Formats
groups.summary: Adapt SEO analysis to language, location, website type and content format.

services.name: International & Multilingual SEO
services.when: Wrong language pages appear or translations miss local intent.
services.work: Review target-market queries, hreflang, canonicals and language URLs.
services.output: Localized intent and technical language-routing recommendations.

services.name: Local SEO & Business Profile Review
services.when: A physical or service-area business needs better local discovery.
services.work: Review eligible local pages, business-information consistency and authorized profile signals.
services.output: Local on-page and business-profile review checklist.

services.name: E-commerce SEO
services.when: Product and category pages are difficult to discover.
services.work: Assess taxonomy, product copy, faceted URLs, internal links and eligible markup.
services.output: Store-template audit and product/category priorities.

services.name: Image & Video Search SEO
services.when: Visual content lacks accessible context or useful metadata.
services.work: Review descriptions, image alternatives, captions and video landing pages.
services.output: Media search optimization checklist for approved assets.

services.name: Large-Site & Template SEO
services.when: Repeated templates create widespread crawl or content problems.
services.work: Sample URL patterns, templates and indexation evidence; use logs when provided.
services.output: Template-level findings and scalable quality controls.

services.name: AI Search Content Readiness
services.when: You want content that modern search interfaces can understand.
services.work: Check accessible answers, attribution, clarity and underlying crawlability.
services.output: Content and technical recommendations; no AI citation guarantee.

groups.name: Research, Implementation & Measurement
groups.summary: Define priorities and verify approved SEO changes with evidence.

services.name: Competitor & SERP Gap Research
services.when: Competitors answer important questions your site misses.
services.work: Inspect organic page types and compare intent and content coverage.
services.output: Competitor reference set and actionable gaps.

services.name: Google Search Console & Analytics
services.when: Performance or indexation changes require investigation.
services.work: Review authorized reports, key landing pages and data quality.
services.output: Evidence-based baseline, anomalies and follow-up measures.

services.name: SEO Implementation & Validation
services.when: Recommendations were made, but changes need acceptance checks.
services.work: Check modified templates, redirects, metadata, links and indexing signals.
services.output: Pass/fail validation report with remaining issues.

services.name: Earned Editorial Visibility Planning
services.when: You want genuine coverage without manufactured ranking links.
services.work: Identify relevant publications and original resources worth citing.
services.output: Ethical outreach plan; no paid ranking links or placement guarantees.

services.name: SEO Consulting & Prioritization
services.when: You need advice on the next SEO decision.
services.work: Review goals, available diagnostics, risks and implementation capacity.
services.output: Scoped priorities and recommendations; implementation agreed separately.

faq.question: Are these 23 separate fixed-price packages?
faq.answer: No. They are SEO workstreams that can be assessed and included in a separately agreed project scope. Each project needs only relevant work.

faq.question: Is implementation included with an audit?
faq.answer: Not automatically. Diagnosis, development and verification are separate responsibilities. Access, implementation steps and deliverables require agreement.

faq.question: Can SEO work guarantee rankings, rich results or AI citations?
faq.answer: No. Search systems determine indexing and presentation. We can identify issues, propose fixes and evaluate evidence, but cannot guarantee inclusion, placement or traffic.

faq.question: Do you sell backlinks or artificial authority scores?
faq.answer: No. Mass backlinks, paid links intended to manipulate rankings, link networks, automated spam and artificial authority metrics are excluded. Earned editorial visibility planning does not promise placements.
